description: This file contains the implementation of the AesGcm class, providing a polyfill for AES-GCM encryption and decryption with specific caveats, including support for certain key sizes and nonce lengths.

classes.name: AesGcm
classes.description: Provides a polyfill for AES-GCM encryption/decryption with support for specific key sizes and nonce lengths.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the AesGcm object with a key, key size, and block size, validating parameters.

methods.name: encrypt
methods.description: Performs AES-GCM encryption on plaintext with given nonce, key, and additional data, producing ciphertext and authentication tag.

methods.name: decrypt
methods.description: Performs AES-GCM decryption on ciphertext with given nonce, key, and authentication tag, validating the tag.

methods.name: gmacInit
methods.description: Initializes a GMAC object with nonce and additional authenticated data.
